input.answer: If I have to pick from this page, I'd pick Harel, the "כספי (שקלי)" track (קופה 13254). Harel is a big name I know, the circle says 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, it shows 4.25% over 3 years and 3.08% over 5, and the bank fee is 0.57%. But I wouldn't sign anything until I'd asked you, because I'm not sure "כספי" is really as safe as my deposit.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: "עוקב מדד S&P 500" was the third button and there were English letters. I nearly left. I only stayed because "קופת גמל להשקעה" was already lit up, and that's what I came for.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the column "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול"
stuck.why: "3 שנים 4.25%": is that per year or for all three years? The heading says yearly, but it sits beside "3 שנים". And "לפני דמי ניהול" means the fee still comes off it, so I don't know what I'd really get.

stuck.where: Screens 2 to 6, rows that say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number
stuck.why: I didn't know if that was a warning or just a new track. I stayed away from those.
Every screen was the same dark table full of percentages. By the sixth one I was tired and anxious and stopped. I never got to the end of the list or to any explanation.

used: Heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the highlighted "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" button

Harel rows "כללי" and "מניות", with the large 24.04% that I backed away from as too risky

"מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link (I didn't open it)
The search box, and the top menu "מדריך", "השקעה במדד", "חוקים וכללים"
The little ? icons and the arrows at the left of each row
unsure_meaning: כספי (שקלי): is it like a deposit?
"101%" shares in a Meitav row, which is more than all of it?
"חדש" and "עוד לא דווח" with the orange mark

findings.what: Dark background with grey and small text, hard to read even enlarged. The column headings and the "2026 ספטמבר" lines are pale.
findings.where: All screens, especially the table header

findings.what: English "S&P 500" and index-tracker tracks come right at the top of the filter, which tells someone like me the page isn't for us.
Too many numbers in each row (two fees, two exposures, two returns, the sum), and the same table over and over with no sentence explaining what it means.
Nothing says which tracks are low-risk or how they compare with a bank deposit.
findings.where: Whole page as far as I read

findings.what: The return is "לפני דמי ניהול", so the number I see isn't what I'd get. It's also unclear whether it's per year.
Yellow and teal circles are close in colour and mean nothing to me.
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in place of a number looks like a link or a warning and isn't explained.
Many unfamiliar company names (מור, אנליסט, מיטב) and no bank I know.
